title: Women's College Basketball
description: The Georgia Lady Bulldogs host the Winthrop Eagles for a regular-season match at Stegeman Coliseum. Georgia holds a 3-2 lead in the all-time series against Winthrop. Madison Bush-Lewis leads Winthrop, while forward Blessing Adebanjo paces Georgia.
